empirical_programme: NEON small-mammal fixed 16-site world-survival regime programme
main_contribution: A response-blind finite-world adequacy certificate does not generally imply predictable later contraction; the empirical rule failed prospectively and the one-step observation rule admits a graph-only non-identifiability witness.
stop_rules: No cutoff retuning on consumed outcomes.
No registry repair or reclassification of the seven stopped sites.
No additional candidate search to improve accuracy.
No taxon-level promotion of the guild endpoint.
No change to the closed EOG-WF conclusion.
next_forbidden_work: new biological response access under this programme
